question: Select the antonym of 'Vilify'.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. **Commend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Vilify"** means to speak or write about someone in an abusive, disparaging, or negative manner. (बदनाम करना / निंदा करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The politician was vilified in the press for his controversial remarks.
 
 
 
• **"Commend"** means to praise formally or officially. (प्रशंसा करना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher commended the student for her outstanding performance in the examination.
 
 
 
• Hence, the antonym of **'Vilify'** is **'Commend'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Commend**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Malign** (बदनाम करना / दुर्भावनापूर्ण कहना): To speak harmful untruths about someone.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt hurt when her rivals maligned her reputation with false accusations.
 
 
 
• **Slur** (कलंक लगाना / अपमानजनक टिप्पणी करना): An insinuation or allegation likely to insult someone’s reputation.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless remarks were considered a slur on the community.
 
 
 
• **Defame** (बदनाम करना): To damage the good reputation of someone.
 
 
• **Example:** The celebrity sued the newspaper for trying to defame her with false stories.
